column1: # comment: "AI claim-layer alignments. THE CLAIM PATTERN: the generated claim is the EXISTING gmeow:StandpointClaim (unified observation stance, P9) \u2014 its external bridges (schema:Claim, CRMinf I2 Belief, nanopublication assertion) are cellled here because the AI layer is why they matter, with the subject term owned by the standpoint slice. PROV-O: ModelInvocation/RetrievalEvent are prov:Activity by inheritance through gmeow:Activity (already aligned in the provenance set) \u2014 only the AI-specific seams are added here. ML-Schema: mls:Run is the W3C member-submission counterpart of a model invocation; mls:Model the trained-model artifact a ModelCard describes. Web Annotation: a groundedIn evidence span is near-isomorphic to an oa:Annotation (body = claim node, target = chunk with position selector); the generated projection carries it (P4). CiTO: supportPolarity's supports/refutes mirror cito:supports/cito:disputes at the citation-act level \u2014 relatedMatch (different carrier: span-to-claim stance vs work-to-work intent)."

# # REFUSED (Principles 5/9 — verdict semantics): schema:ClaimReview. Its single reviewRating adjudicates a winner; GMEOW contradictions coexist standpoint-indexed, surfaced by gmeow:Contradiction and never resolved by rank.
# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — scope mismatch): C2PA Content Credentials sign MEDIA provenance at the container level, not statement-level claims; the attestation slice owns that seam.

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — no RDF vocabulary): Model Cards (the Mitchell et al. practice) and FAIR4ML have no stable RDF namespace to cell against; mls:Model is the nearest stable term and is cellled. Revisit when a W3C/community namespace stabilizes.
# # REFUSED (Principle 15 — instance data, not TBox): RAGAS/ARES/AIS/RAGTruth metric vocabularies land as Criterion individuals in the published rubric, not as term alignments.

column6: a chunk IS located the way a position selector locates (start/end into a source); the selector is the locator, the chunk the located segment — relatedMatch, not equivalence
Wikidata 'logical contradiction' — GMEOW's individual is the SURFACED conflict artifact, attributed and kind-classified; curl-validated 2026-06-12
mls:Model is the trained artifact itself; the ModelCard is the description OF one — the nearest stable RDF term (Model Cards proper have no RDF namespace; see trailer)
ML-Schema's Run is the executed model task; GMEOW's invocation adds prompt + sampling provenance
a prompt is a prov:Entity used by the invocation activity; PROV-O has nothing finer
Wikidata 'prompt engineering' — the practice around the artifact (no artifact-level QID exists); curl-validated 2026-06-12
CRMinf's belief (a proposition held by an agent) is the heritage-argumentation cousin of the standpoint-indexed claim; CRMinf adds inference-making machinery GMEOW keeps in the solver layer
schema:Claim is the fact-check-markup claim; a StandpointClaim carries vantage/modality/confidence the schema.org term lacks — the projection emits text + appearance and NO reviewRating
Wikidata 'statement' — that which a true-or-false sentence asserts; curl-validated 2026-06-12
a nanopublication's assertion graph plays the claim-content role; nanopubs package assertion+provenance+pubinfo as named graphs where GMEOW uses RDF 1.2 statement annotations
in the Web Annotation projection the claim is the annotation body and the evidence span its target; directions differ, hence relatedMatch
the schema-org projection composes claim→span→chunk→source into schema:appearance (the claim appears in that work); the term-level relation is loose, the composed path faithful
the provider's wire-level version tag, on the described agent in the projection
CiTO's disputes, at the span-to-claim level
CiTO's supports is a work-to-work citation intent; GMEOW's polarity is a span-to-claim stance — same epistemics, different carrier
oa:TextPositionSelector's start — same unicode code-point semantics
